title: The Suffering Servant

questions.question: Who has believed what he has heard from us? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:1 (ESV): "And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?"

questions.question: For he grew up before him like a young plant, and like a root out of dry what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:2 (ESV): "and like a root out of dry ground;"

questions.question: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows and acquainted with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:3 (ESV): "a man of sorrows and acquainted with grief;"

questions.question: Surely he has borne our griefs and carried our what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:4 (ESV): "Surely he has borne our griefs and carried our sorrows;"

questions.question: But he was pierced for our transgressions; he was crushed for our what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:5 (ESV): "he was crushed for our iniquities;"

questions.question: Upon him was the chastisement that brought us peace, and with his wounds we are what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:5 (ESV): "and with his wounds we are healed."

questions.question: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned—every one—to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:6 (ESV): "and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all."

questions.question: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:7 (ESV): "yet he opened not his mouth;"

questions.question: Like a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and like a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he opened not his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:7 (ESV): "so he opened not his mouth."

questions.question: And they made his grave with the wicked and with a rich man in his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:9 (ESV): "and with a rich man in his death,"

questions.question: Yet it was the will of the LORD to crush him; he has put him to grief; when his soul makes an offering for guilt, he shall see his what?
He shall see and be satisfied; by his knowledge shall the righteous one, my servant, make many to be accounted what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:11 (ESV): "make many to be accounted righteous,"

questions.question: Therefore I will divide him a portion with the many, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong, because he poured out his soul to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:12 (ESV): "because he poured out his soul to death"

questions.question: And was numbered with the transgressors; yet he bore the sin of many, and makes intercession for the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:12 (ESV): "and makes intercession for the transgressors."

questions.question: By oppression and judgment he was taken away; and as for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 53:8 (ESV): "cut off out of the land of the living,"

key_verse_text: But he was pierced for our transgressions; he was crushed for our iniquities; upon him was the chastisement that brought us peace, and with his wounds we are healed.
